name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility index MOVE at 96 on 19 Nov, below 100; US 10-year yield 5.05%, up 10bp over a month
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 96 on 19 Nov, down 2.4% on the week and below the 100 Watch line for a second day; Watch is kept until it falls clearly below (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 5.05%, about 10bp higher over the month and inside the 40bp line, after touching 5.11% on 19 Nov as Fed minutes revived rate-rise expectations (CoinDesk).
for_you: US borrowing costs are high and sensitive to Fed news. Mortgage rates and other loans priced off Treasury yields are exposed to further swings.
rubric_hit: MOVE 96 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofA MOVE Index (^MOVE)
CoinDesk — Bitcoin plunges to lowest since July as broader markets tumble

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
